factors.label: Yesterday's range vs 20-day ADR
factors.mechanism: a big day yesterday leaves fewer fresh pools and a tired tape

factors.label: Overnight range vs ADR
factors.mechanism: a wide overnight session has already used part of the day's travel

factors.label: Size of the 09:30 gap vs ADR
factors.mechanism: gaps attract fills: a big gap means a fight at the open

factors.label: Gap in the trade's direction
factors.mechanism: trading with the gap is continuation; against it is the gap fill

factors.label: Opening 15-minute range vs ADR
factors.mechanism: a wild open means the sweep was made by the opening drive

factors.label: Yesterday was an inside day
factors.mechanism: compression before expansion: inside days precede range days

factors.label: 3+ closes in a row in the trade's direction
factors.mechanism: a stretched streak means the sweep is a late continuation

factors.label: Days since the last 2% day (recent vs old)
factors.mechanism: fresh shocks mean fatter tails and less respect for pools

factors.label: Last week's range vs the prior 4 weeks
factors.mechanism: a quiet week sets up a lively one

factors.label: Where yesterday closed in its range
factors.mechanism: a close at the extreme means the overnight builds the next pool

factors.label: Entry on the trade's side of the 09:30 open
factors.mechanism: buying above the open is chasing; buying below it is a discount vs the open

factors.label: Range already travelled before the signal vs ADR
factors.mechanism: the day has a budget; a late sweep has less left

factors.label: Sweep extreme made before 09:30
factors.mechanism: a pre-market sweep is run by the overnight book, not the cash session

factors.label: Minutes from the sweep to the trigger
factors.mechanism: a fast reclaim means a true stop-run; a slow one is acceptance

factors.label: Size of the sweep bar vs 5m ATR
factors.mechanism: a climactic sweep bar flushes stops at once

factors.label: VIX change over 5 days
factors.mechanism: rising fear raises the odds a pool holds

factors.label: VIX vs its 20-day average
factors.mechanism: vol above its own norm means wider ranges, wider stops

factors.label: VXN minus VIX (tech vol premium)
factors.mechanism: when tech vol is dear vs the S&P, NQ is the one moving

factors.label: Dealer gamma positive (SqueezeMetrics GEX)
factors.mechanism: positive gamma pins price, negative gamma lets it run

factors.label: GEX percentile (1 year)
factors.mechanism: extreme gamma = extreme pinning / extreme trend

factors.label: DIX (dark-pool buying) above its median
factors.mechanism: quiet institutional buying supports the long side

factors.label: IFVG / CISD zone height vs 5m ATR
factors.mechanism: a tall gap means a violent reversal; a thin one is noise

factors.label: Pools swept at once (1 vs 2+)
factors.mechanism: a stacked raid takes more stops and has more fuel

factors.label: Trigger candle size vs 5m ATR
factors.mechanism: a big trigger candle means part of the move is spent

factors.label: Distance to target vs 5m ATR
factors.mechanism: a far pool is a long trip through noise

factors.label: Minutes into the killzone at entry
factors.mechanism: the first 45 minutes of a killzone are the manipulation leg

factors.label: Signal-bar volume vs the same clock bar (20 days)
factors.mechanism: a quiet trigger bar has no one behind it

factors.label: Swept pool is a prior-day / prior-week level
factors.mechanism: older levels hold more resting orders

factors.label: Trades already taken this week
factors.mechanism: the third setup of the week is the leftover one

factors.label: Equity slope: last 10 trades net positive
factors.mechanism: hot and cold stretches cluster beyond the 15-trade filter

factors.label: The last trading day's trade won
factors.mechanism: a winner yesterday means the regime is paying

factors.label: Days since the previous trade (gap of 2+ days)
factors.mechanism: a quiet spell means the market had no clean pools

factors.label: Month-to-date R positive
factors.mechanism: months trend
